item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to preserve the ace of spades and discard all other cards: a tapped pair remains only when it includes the ace of spades, and at the final tap the ace of spades remains while the other card is discarded."}
